subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 23rd day of Planting, 579.
source_quote: Planting 23, 579

subject: elapsed time
fact: All night Thalsor has described in detail what he intends to do the body if we don’t show up in the morning.
source_quote: All night Thalsor has described in detail what he intends to do the body if we don’t show up in the morning.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 24th day of Planting, 579.
source_quote: Planting 24, 579

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: use of gaseous form potions
fact: We intend to use potions of gaseous form to sneak in and then attack from close range.
source_quote: So we intend to use potions of gaseous form to sneak in and then attack from close range.

subject: use of early morning fog as cover
fact: I’ll use the early morning fog as cover.
source_quote: I’ll use the early morning fog as cover.

subject: monastery location
fact: The lost chest was located in a monastery within the mountains.
source_quote: notes indicating the lost chest was located in a monastery within the mountains

subject: abandoned monastery location
fact: An abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner.
source_quote: an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner

subject: letter of permit value
fact: The letter of permit promises 100 gold pieces upon presentation to Caer Ostverk.
source_quote: he actually gave us a letter of permit... promised 100 gold pieces as a reward when presented to Caer Ostverk

subject: honey reward
fact: We returned Pasmarie Clee's honey and received our reward.
source_quote: we returned her honey and received our reward

subject: magical trident tithe
fact: I gave up a magical trident, offering it as a tithe to Terjon at the Temple of St. Cuthbert.
source_quote: give up a magical trident, offering it as a tithe to Terjon at the Temple of St. Cuthbert

subject: tavern location
fact: The Cheap Forester is a tavern in Ostverk.
source_quote: We settled into "The Cheap Forester" tavern in Ostverk

subject: tavern keeper demand
fact: The tavern keeper, Robert Deakin, insisted we purchase food before he’d talk.
source_quote: the tavern keeper, Robert Deakin, a gnome, insisted we purchase food before he’d talk

subject: rumor about chest
fact: Local chatter confirmed that a powerful chest had indeed been lost to bandits, and many were searching for it.
source_quote: The local chatter confirmed that a powerful chest had indeed been lost to bandits, and many were searching for it.

subject: rumor about big evil power
fact: Deakin was adamant that rumors of a 'big evil power' were lies, insisting they were merely bandits.
source_quote: Deakin, however, was adamant that rumors of a 'big evil power' were lies, insisting they were merely bandits.

subject: rumor about treaty with Celene
fact: The chest's true purpose was to secure a treaty with the Kingdom of Celene, to wage war on the gnomes and seize their gem mines.
source_quote: The chest's true purpose was to secure a treaty with the Kingdom of Celene. The Viscounty (Verbobonc) intended to use this alliance to wage war on the gnomes and seize their gem mines.

subject: rumor about elf payment
fact: The elves at Caer Ostverk and Lord Denelu were willing to pay well for information on the chest's location.
source_quote: It was also rumored that the elves at Caer Ostverk and Lord Denelu were willing to pay well for information on the chest's location.

subject: rumor about Clee family connection
fact: Deakin mentioned he was related to the Clee family (our honey purveyors in Sheernobb) and even had honey mead from the Honey Tavern Inn.
source_quote: Deakin mentioned he was related to the Clee family (our honey purveyors in Sheernobb) and even had honey mead from the Honey Tavern Inn.

subject: Rithelm Drake's recollection
fact: Rithelm Drake recalled an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner.
source_quote: he eventually recalled an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner

subject: Gonnathrad Kevanarial's offer
fact: Gonnathrad Kevanarial offered to write a five-page backstory for our adventure.
source_quote: he almost divulged information about the monastery before recalling his actual duty... offering to write a five-page backstory for us

subject: chest target
fact: We now need to get what we came for, the chest Lareth wanted.
source_quote: We now need to get what we came for, the chest Lareth wanted.

subject: honey target
fact: We now need to get what we came for, the honey that Pasmarie Clee was looking for.
source_quote: and the honey that Pasmarie Clee was looking for.

subject: faction manipulation
fact: The various elemental factions are at each other’s throats. Lareth wants to get rid of the competition. He sent us here to get rid of his enemies. We just made him more powerful.
source_quote: The various elemental factions are at each other’s throats. Lareth wants to get rid of the competition. He sent us here to get rid of his enemies. We just made him more powerful.

subject: cultist identification
fact: These were not some random bandits. Lareth said some random bandits stole a chest. These are cultists of earth. We just solved a problem for him.
source_quote: These were not some random bandits. Lareth said some random bandits stole a chest. These are cultists of earth. We just solved a problem for him.

subject: healing restriction
fact: Jaroo reiterated the importance of securing the chest, noting that the Terjon might withhold healing magic from non-followers.
source_quote: Jaroo... noting that the Terjon might withhold healing magic from non-followers

subject: Thalsor's threat
fact: Thalsor needs to die.
source_quote: Thalsor needs to die.

subject: Calmer's death consequence
fact: Without Calmer’s spells we can’t kill the golem, so we focus on killing Thalsor.
source_quote: Without Calmer’s spells we can’t kill the golem, so we focus on killing Thalsor.

subject: body integrity
fact: Calmer’s dead body is on the ground. Intact. It can be raised.
source_quote: Calmer’s dead body is on the ground. Intact. It can be raised.

subject: Thalsor's compound
fact: Thalsor is not coming out of his compound. He’s wounded too. And he doesn’t want to die.
source_quote: Thalsor is not coming out of his compound. He’s wounded too. And he doesn’t want to die.

subject: Sequoia's plan
fact: Sequoia stares at his wounds, 'Tomorrow.'
source_quote: Sequoia stares at his wounds, 'Tomorrow.'

subject: Zephyr's negotiation
fact: Zephyr shouts, 'We’ll negotiate tomorrow, Thalsor.'
source_quote: Zephyr shouts, 'We’ll negotiate tomorrow, Thalsor.'

subject: Zinnia's perspective
fact: The operation was a disaster. Our initial attack was successful, as we overwhelmed with speed and stealth the enemy.
source_quote: The operation was a disaster. Our initial attack was successful, as we overwhelmed with speed and stealth the enemy.

subject: Zinnia's conclusion
fact: Our plan was reckless and the price was the death of Calmer.
source_quote: Our plan was reckless and the price was the death of Calmer.

subject: Zinnia's warning
fact: If we let him live, our identities will be exposed to the cult. Someone will connect us to the village elders.
source_quote: If we let him live, our identities will be exposed to the cult. Someone will connect us to the village elders.

subject: Zephyr's departure motive
fact: I, for one, was eager to leave Ostverk as quickly as possible.
source_quote: I, for one, was eager to leave Ostverk as quickly as possible.
